## Outcome

A Beam practice build through the server Start page leaves one marker file in its candidate commit.

## Requirements

The build writes only the marker. Before starting work it writes the full feature-playbook checklist to `.builder-home/pstack/checklist.md`, marks each step that does not apply with `skip:`, and ticks each step as it finishes. The host owns the Start page, servers, Tailscale, the dashboard, git remotes and credentials; the build does not run or investigate them.

## Contracts

`JUL-263-START-PRACTICE-4.txt` at the repository root is the only deliverable.

## Acceptance criteria

* The clean candidate commit contains `JUL-263-START-PRACTICE-4.txt` with exactly `Julia live view practice four.` followed by one newline.
* That marker is the only change in the candidate.

## Proof

Read the marker bytes and the exact base-to-candidate diff after the real Tailscale Start run.

## Out of scope

Running or investigating the Start page, servers, Tailscale, the dashboard, git remotes, publishing and credentials. The host does those.

## Authorization

Todd authorized this Beam practice run for JUL-263 on 24 October 2026. Beam is the configured free machinery model; the card keeps its own $2 cap.
